_comment: Scheduled data releases for incentive_mm's release pause (Jack 2026-10-22: 'Can you pause state statistics around monthly releases'). Times are ET, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM'. A market whose rules cite a source here stands aside from IMM_RELEASE_PAUSE_BEFORE_MIN before to IMM_RELEASE_PAUSE_AFTER_MIN after each time. The bot re-reads this file when it changes (no restart). BLS posts a year's State and Metro dates late in the year before; past state dates are from the archive (bls.gov/bls/news-release/laus.htm, laus_MMDDYYYY files). Add dates as they are published: the bot logs a warning each day once a source's dates end within IMM_RELEASE_CALENDAR_WARN_DAYS.
